map.粘贴网页或文章正文并输入目标关键词，统计关键词出现频次与密度百分比，帮助优化内容: Paste a web page or article body and enter the target keyword to count keyword frequency and density percentage, helping optimize SEO keyword layout and avoid stuffing risk.
map.写 SEO 文章时检测目标词是否堆砌或不足。: When writing SEO articles, check whether the target term is stuffed or underused.
map.中文按「出现字数/总中文字数」、英文按「词频/总词数」算密度。: For Chinese it uses "occurrences in characters / total Chinese characters", for English "word frequency / total words".
map.给出 1%–3% 健康区间建议。: Gives a suggested healthy range of 1%-3%.
map.：关键词「减肥」出现 5 次（每词 2 字共 10 字），正文总中文 500 字: : the keyword "weight loss" appears 5 times (2 characters each, 10 characters total) in a body of 500 Chinese characters -> density = (10/500) x 100 = 2%, inside the healthy 1%-3% range.
map.：同词出现 20 次（40 字）/500 字 → 密度 8% 过高，可能被判定堆: : the same term appearing 20 times (40 characters) out of 500 characters -> density 8%, too high, likely judged as stuffing, so dilute it to about 5 occurrences.
map.是经验区间，不是算法硬线。重点在自然通顺，硬凑密度反而伤体验与被降权。: It is an empirical range, not a hard algorithm threshold. The point is to read naturally; forcing density hurts the experience and can trigger downranking.
map.中英文算法为什么不同？: Why do the Chinese and English algorithms differ?
map.中文无空格分词，按字频更稳；英文按词频。工具自动区分处理。: Chinese has no spaces for word segmentation, so character frequency is more stable; English uses word frequency. The tool distinguishes them automatically.
